title: Making a String
statementMd:
You are given an alphabet consisting of $*n*$ letters, your task is to make a string of the maximum possible length so that the following conditions are satisfied:

- the $*i*$-th letter occurs in the string no more than $*a*_{*i*}$ times;
- the number of occurrences of each letter in the string must be **distinct** for all the letters that occurred in the string at least once.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($2  ≤  *n*  ≤  26$) — the number of letters in the alphabet.

The next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — $*i*$-th of these integers gives the limitation on the number of occurrences of the $*i*$-th character in the string.

## Output

Print a single integer — the maximum length of the string that meets all the requirements.

## Note

For convenience let's consider an alphabet consisting of three letters: "`a`", "`b`", "`c`". In the first sample, some of the optimal strings are: "`cccaabbccbb`", "`aabcbcbcbcb`". In the second sample some of the optimal strings are: "`acc`", "`cbc`".
statementZhMd:
你有一个由 $*n*$ 个字母组成的字母表，你的任务是构造一个满足以下条件且长度尽可能大的字符串：

- 第 $*i*$ 个字母在字符串中的出现次数不超过 $*a*_{*i*}$；
- 对于所有至少在字符串中出现过一次的字母，它们在字符串中的出现次数必须各不相同。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2  ≤  *n* ≤  26$）——字母表中字母的数量。

下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——其中第 $*i*$ 个整数表示第 $*i*$ 个字符在字符串中出现次数的上限。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——满足所有要求的字符串的最大长度。

## 说明

为方便起见，我们考虑一个由三个字母组成的字母表："`a`"、"`b`"、"`c`"。在第一个样例中，一些最优字符串为："`cccaabbccbb`"、"`aabcbcbcbcb`"。在第二个样例中，一些最优字符串为："`acc`"、"`cbc`"。
